_about: 1-Hexanol (1) + o-Xylene (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 95.6 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-hexanol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: K. S. Reddy, A. V. N. Swamy, T. E. V. Prasad, D. H. L. Prasad, Bubble point measurements of binary mixtures formed by 1-hexanol with selected nitro-compounds and substituted benzenes at 95.6 kPa , Fluid Phase Equilib. 298 (2010) 276-279
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 21. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.76 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
